blocks.en: USP ⟨1229.11⟩ Vapor Phase Sterilization — Complete Teaching Edition

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解汽相滅菌（Vapor Phase Sterilization）的基本原理：利用懸浮於空氣中的殺孢子劑（sporicidal agents）進行表面滅菌
blocks.en: Understand the basic principle of vapor phase sterilization: surface sterilization using sporicidal agents suspended in the air

blocks.zh: 掌握氣化過氧化氫（VPHP / H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub>）與過氧乙酸（Peracetic Acid）兩大汽相滅菌劑的特性與應用
blocks.en: Master the characteristics and applications of the two main vapor phase sterilants: vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VPHP / H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub>) and peracetic acid

blocks.zh: 了解汽相滅菌獨特的多相（multiphase）特性 — 為何無法建立標準化 D 值
blocks.en: Understand the unique multiphase nature of vapor phase sterilization, and why a standardized D-value cannot be established

blocks.zh: 認識半週期法（Half-Cycle）與括弧法（Bracketing）兩種驗證策略
blocks.en: Become familiar with the two validation strategies: the half-cycle approach and the bracketing approach

blocks.zh: 掌握設備確認、空腔分布、負載圖譜、生物指示劑（BI）應用等驗證活動
blocks.en: Master the validation activities: equipment qualification, cavity distribution, load mapping, and application of biological indicators (BIs)

blocks.zh: 了解常規製程控制的基本要求，維持已驗證狀態
blocks.en: Understand the basic requirements for routine process control to maintain the validated state

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 無法標準化 D 值 — 這是汽相滅菌最獨特之處：
blocks.en: No standardized D-value: the most distinctive feature of vapor phase sterilization:

blocks.zh: 蒸汽滅菌（121°C）和乾熱滅菌（250°C）都有明確的 D 值，因為製程條件單一且可控。但汽相滅菌由於多相特性：
blocks.en: Steam sterilization (121°C) and dry heat sterilization (250°C) both have well-defined D-values because the process conditions are uniform and controllable. Vapor phase sterilization, however, is multiphase:

blocks.zh: 氣相和液相的殺菌速率不同（液相殺菌力通常高於氣相）
blocks.en: The microbial kill rates of the gas phase and the liquid phase differ (the liquid phase is usually more lethal than the gas phase)

blocks.zh: 不同表面上的凝結量、濕度、濃度各不相同
blocks.en: Condensation, humidity, and concentration differ from one surface to another

blocks.zh: 線上監測氣相濃度與實際表面殺菌效果之間無已證實的相關性
blocks.en: There is no demonstrated correlation between online monitoring of gas-phase concentration and the actual kill on surfaces

blocks.zh: 因此，汽相滅菌驗證必須採用經驗性方法（empirical approach）— 透過 BI 全面挑戰來證明製程效果，而非依賴理論計算。
blocks.en: Therefore, validation of vapor phase sterilization must use an empirical approach: the process effect is demonstrated through a comprehensive BI challenge rather than by theoretical calculation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 噴霧清潔劑 vs 蒸氣清潔：
blocks.en: Spray cleaner vs. steam cleaning:

blocks.zh: 想像你用噴霧瓶對房間噴灑消毒劑。噴出的霧滴有些在空中飄浮（氣相），有些直接落在桌面凝結成水珠（液相），有些角落可能噴不到（死角）。你無法單靠測量空氣中的消毒劑濃度來判斷每個表面是否都被充分消毒 — 你必須實際去每個角落貼試紙來確認。這就是為什麼汽相滅菌需要大量的 BI 分布測試，而不是依賴線上氣體濃度監測。
blocks.en: Imagine using a spray bottle to disinfect a room. Some of the droplets float in the air (gas phase), some land on the desk and condense into beads of water (liquid phase), and some corners may never get sprayed (dead spots). You cannot judge whether every surface has been adequately disinfected just by measuring the disinfectant concentration in the air; you have to go to every corner and place a test strip to confirm. This is why vapor phase sterilization needs extensive BI distribution testing rather than reliance on online gas concentration monitoring.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 汽相滅菌（Vapor Phase Sterilization）：利用殺孢子劑的蒸氣狀態，對容器或腔室內的表面進行滅菌。關鍵特徵：
blocks.en: Vapor phase sterilization: uses the vapor state of a sporicidal agent to sterilize surfaces inside a container or chamber. Key features:

blocks.zh: 多相系統（Multiphase） — 滅菌過程中，腔室內同時存在氣相和液相（凝結液滴），這是與氣體滅菌（如 EtO）最根本的區別
blocks.en: Multiphase system — during sterilization, both gas phase and liquid phase (condensed droplets) are present in the chamber. This is the most fundamental difference from gas sterilization (e.g., EtO)

blocks.zh: 表面滅菌 — 汽相滅菌主要作用於物件表面，不適合穿透性滅菌。所有表面必須充分暴露（fully exposed）
blocks.en: Surface sterilization — vapor phase sterilization acts mainly on the surfaces of items and is not suited to penetrating sterilization. All surfaces must be fully exposed

blocks.zh: 適合熱敏感材料 — 在室溫或近室溫條件下操作，是隔離器（isolator）和 RABS 內部去污（bio-decontamination）的首選方法
blocks.en: Suitable for heat-sensitive materials — it operates at or near room temperature, and is the preferred method for bio-decontamination inside isolators and RABS

blocks.zh: 四大汽相滅菌劑：
blocks.en: The four main vapor phase sterilants:

blocks.zh: Hydrogen Peroxide — 過氧化氫
blocks.en: Hydrogen Peroxide

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO Practical Insights
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Insights

blocks.zh: H2O2 注射策略：
blocks.en: H2O2 injection strategies:

blocks.zh: 連續注射（Continuous）— H2O2 持續供給，維持穩定氣相濃度。優點：均勻性好。缺點：可能過度凝結
blocks.en: Continuous — H2O2 is supplied continuously to maintain a stable gas-phase concentration. Advantage: good uniformity. Disadvantage: possible over-condensation

blocks.zh: 間歇注射（Intermittent / Pulsed）— 分多次脈衝注入，中間有乾燥間歇。許多現代隔離器系統採用此方式
blocks.en: Intermittent / Pulsed — injected in multiple pulses with drying intervals in between. Many modern isolator systems use this approach

blocks.zh: 一次注射（All at once / Flash）— 一次性注入全部 H2O2。常見於較小型系統
blocks.en: All at once / Flash — all of the H2O2 is injected in a single shot. Commonly seen in smaller systems

blocks.zh: 曝氣優化是 CDMO 效率的關鍵：隔離器去污週期中，曝氣（aeration）往往是最耗時的階段。典型去污週期可能需要 2-4 小時，其中曝氣可佔 1.5-3 小時。透過優化進氣流量、HEPA 過濾器配置、催化分解等手段，可以顯著縮短曝氣時間，直接提升產線利用率。
blocks.en: Aeration optimization is the key to CDMO efficiency: in an isolator decontamination cycle, aeration is often the most time-consuming phase. A typical decontamination cycle may take 2-4 hours, of which aeration can account for 1.5-3 hours. By optimizing inlet airflow, HEPA filter configuration, catalytic decomposition, and similar measures, aeration time can be shortened significantly, directly improving line utilization.

blocks.zh: 烤箱的預熱與散熱：
blocks.en: Preheating and cooling an oven:

blocks.zh: VPHP 週期就像使用烤箱：先預熱（conditioning），然後維持烘烤溫度（decontamination），烤完後必須等烤箱降溫才能安全打開門取出食物（aeration）。就像你不會在烤箱還是 200°C 時就打開門一樣，你也不能在 H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> 殘留量還很高時就打開隔離器。而且降溫（曝氣）通常比烘烤本身還花時間 — 這正是 CDMO 想要優化的痛點。
blocks.en: A VPHP cycle is like using an oven: you first preheat it (conditioning), then hold the baking temperature (decontamination), and after baking you must wait for the oven to cool before you can safely open the door and take the food out (aeration). Just as you would not open the oven door while it is still at 200°C, you cannot open the isolator while the H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> residue is still high. Moreover, cooling down (aeration) usually takes longer than the baking itself, which is exactly the pain point CDMOs want to optimize.

blocks.en: VPHP Cycle Phases

blocks.en: The four typical phases of a VPHP decontamination cycle:

blocks.zh: Peracetic Acid — 過氧乙酸
blocks.en: Peracetic Acid

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 PAA vs VPHP
blocks.en: PAA vs. VPHP

blocks.zh: 過氧乙酸（PAA）的特點：
blocks.en: Characteristics of peracetic acid (PAA):

blocks.zh: 引入方式 — 以液態通過霧化器（atomizer）引入，而非像 H2O2 那樣通過蒸發器汽化。因此液相成分更多
blocks.en: Method of introduction — introduced as a liquid through an atomizer, rather than vaporized in an evaporator as H2O2 is. As a result, the liquid-phase component is larger

blocks.zh: 可單獨使用或與 H2O2 混合使用 — 混合配方可提供協同殺菌效果
blocks.en: Can be used alone or mixed with H2O2 — mixed formulations can provide a synergistic microbicidal effect

blocks.zh: 去除方式 — 透過蒸發去除，不需要像 H2O2 那樣的專門曝氣步驟，但殘留物（醋酸）可能需要額外考量
blocks.en: Method of removal — removed by evaporation; no dedicated aeration step like that for H2O2 is needed, but the residue (acetic acid) may require additional consideration

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO Context
blocks.en: CDMO Context

blocks.zh: VPHP vs PAA 選擇考量：
blocks.en: Considerations when choosing between VPHP and PAA:

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌充填環境中，VPHP 幾乎是隔離器去污的唯一選擇。PAA 更常用於非隔離器環境的大面積去污。
blocks.en: In a CDMO aseptic filling environment, VPHP is almost the only choice for isolator decontamination. PAA is more often used for large-area decontamination in non-isolator environments.

blocks.zh: Validation of Vapor Sterilization — 汽相滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Vapor Sterilization

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Empirical Approach
blocks.en: Empirical Approach

blocks.zh: 經驗性方法的核心邏輯：
blocks.en: The core logic of the empirical approach:

blocks.zh: 起始：在系統各處分布 BI（含已知數量的抗性芽孢）
blocks.en: Start: distribute BIs (containing a known number of resistant spores) throughout the system

blocks.zh: 尋找最短殺菌時間：從短週期開始，逐步增加暴露時間，直到所有 BI 均被滅殺 — 這就是 minimum lethal time
blocks.en: Find the minimum lethal time: start with a short cycle and gradually increase the exposure time until all BIs are killed. This is the minimum lethal time

blocks.zh: 建立安全裕度：半週期法直接將此時間加倍；括弧法則另外測試更長時間以評估材料影響上限
blocks.en: Build a safety margin: the half-cycle approach simply doubles this time; the bracketing approach additionally tests longer times to assess the upper limit of material effects

blocks.zh: 常規使用：在安全裕度範圍內的參數進行日常操作
blocks.en: Routine use: daily operation is carried out with parameters within the safety margin

blocks.zh: 這種方法之所以必要，是因為無法像蒸汽滅菌那樣用 D 值和 F<sub>0</sub> 值進行理論計算。你必須用實際實驗來「證明」你的週期有效。
blocks.en: This approach is necessary because, unlike steam sterilization, you cannot use theoretical calculations based on D-values and F<sub>0</sub> values. You must "prove" that your cycle is effective through actual experiments.

blocks.zh: 微波爐加熱食物：
blocks.en: Heating food in a microwave:

blocks.zh: 半週期法就像用微波爐加熱便當：你先試 2 分鐘發現中心還是冷的，試 3 分鐘還是不夠，試 4 分鐘終於全部熱透了（minimum lethal time = 4 分鐘）。為了安全，你每次都設定 8 分鐘（2 倍）。括弧法則是你還會額外試 10 分鐘、12 分鐘，看看便當會不會過熱變乾（材料損傷上限），最後決定日常設定 8-10 分鐘。
blocks.en: The half-cycle approach is like reheating a lunch box in a microwave: you try 2 minutes and find the center still cold, 3 minutes is still not enough, and at 4 minutes it is finally hot all the way through (minimum lethal time = 4 minutes). To be safe, you always set 8 minutes (2 times). With the bracketing approach, you would additionally try 10 and 12 minutes to see whether the lunch box overheats and dries out (the upper limit of material damage), and finally decide on a daily setting of 8-10 minutes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO Isolator Validation
blocks.en: CDMO Isolator Validation

blocks.zh: 隔離器 VPHP 去污驗證的實務要點：
blocks.en: Practical points for isolator VPHP decontamination validation:

blocks.zh: BI 選擇：常用 Geobacillus stearothermophilus 芽孢，以不鏽鋼或玻璃載體承載。數量通常 106 CFU/carrier（注意：D 值無法標準化，應在自身系統中驗證）
blocks.en: BI selection: Geobacillus stearothermophilus spores are commonly used, carried on stainless steel or glass carriers. The population is usually 106 CFU/carrier (note: the D-value cannot be standardized and should be verified in your own system)

blocks.zh: BI 分布位置：至少覆蓋最難到達（worst-case）位置 — 如門密封條附近、角落、管路接頭、手套口等
blocks.en: BI placement: cover at least the hardest-to-reach (worst-case) locations, such as near door seals, corners, pipe connections, and glove ports

blocks.zh: 多個 BI 原則：USP 建議每個位置放置多個 BI — 這提高了統計可信度，避免單一 BI 的假陽性/假陰性影響結論
blocks.en: Multiple-BI principle: USP recommends placing multiple BIs at each location. This increases statistical confidence and prevents a false positive or false negative from a single BI from affecting the conclusion

blocks.zh: 重複性：製程確認需要重複研究（replicate studies），通常至少三次連續成功的 BI 全滅殺
blocks.en: Repeatability: process qualification requires replicate studies, usually at least three consecutive successful runs with all BIs killed

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Material Compatibility
blocks.en: Material Compatibility

blocks.zh: 材料相容性測試 — USP 未明說但 CDMO 必須考慮：
blocks.en: Material compatibility testing: not explicitly stated in USP, but a CDMO must consider it:

blocks.zh: 手套材質：Hypalon®（CSM）是最常見的隔離器手套材料，對 H2O2 耐受性佳，但仍需定期更換（通常每 200-500 週期或按 SOP 規定）
blocks.en: Glove material: Hypalon® (CSM) is the most common isolator glove material and tolerates H2O2 well, but it still needs regular replacement (usually every 200-500 cycles, or as specified in the SOP)

blocks.zh: 密封墊圈：EPDM 橡膠通常兼容；天然橡膠和某些矽膠可能加速老化
blocks.en: Gaskets: EPDM rubber is generally compatible; natural rubber and some silicones may age faster

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼 316L：與 H2O2 兼容，但長期暴露於 PAA 可能出現腐蝕
blocks.en: Stainless steel 316L: compatible with H2O2, but long-term exposure to PAA may cause corrosion

blocks.zh: 塑膠組件：PC（聚碳酸酯）觀察窗可能出現霧化或龜裂 — 需追蹤週期數
blocks.en: Plastic components: PC (polycarbonate) viewing windows may become hazy or crack, so the number of cycles should be tracked

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Validation Activities Summary
blocks.en: Validation Activities Summary

blocks.zh: 六大驗證活動一覽：
blocks.en: Overview of the six validation activities:

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Ongoing Control
blocks.en: Ongoing Control

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽查常見問題：
blocks.en: Common CDMO audit questions:

blocks.zh: BI 使用頻率 — FDA 和 EU Annex 1 對隔離器去污常規 BI 使用有不同期望。保守做法：每次生產批次使用 BI；部分公司根據風險評估降低頻率，但需有科學依據和數據支持
blocks.en: BI use frequency — the FDA and EU Annex 1 have different expectations for routine BI use in isolator decontamination. The conservative practice is to use BIs for every production batch; some companies reduce the frequency based on a risk assessment, but this requires scientific justification and supporting data

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析 — 監控週期參數（注射量、曝氣時間、殘留 H2O2 水平）的長期趨勢，及早偵測設備性能劣化
blocks.en: Trend analysis — monitor long-term trends in cycle parameters (injection amount, aeration time, residual H2O2 level) to detect equipment performance degradation early

blocks.zh: 變更管制觸發再驗證 — 更換手套、更換 HEPA、更換 H2O2 供應商或濃度，均需評估是否觸發再驗證
blocks.en: Change control triggers revalidation — replacing gloves, replacing HEPA filters, or changing the H2O2 supplier or concentration must all be assessed for whether they trigger revalidation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Maintaining Validated State
blocks.en: Maintaining Validated State

blocks.zh: 九大維持驗證狀態的基本要素：
blocks.en: The nine basic elements for maintaining the validated state:

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 汽相滅菌（Vapor Phase Sterilization）利用殺孢子劑蒸氣對表面進行滅菌，是隔離器和 RABS 去污的標準方法
blocks.en: Vapor phase sterilization uses sporicidal agent vapor to sterilize surfaces and is the standard method for isolator and RABS decontamination

blocks.zh: 多相特性（Multiphase Nature）是汽相滅菌的核心挑戰 — 氣相和液相共存，導致無法建立標準化 D 值，必須採用經驗性方法驗證
blocks.en: The multiphase nature is the central challenge of vapor phase sterilization: gas and liquid phases coexist, so a standardized D-value cannot be established and an empirical approach must be used for validation

blocks.zh: H2O2（VPHP）是製藥隔離器去污的首選滅菌劑；過氧乙酸（PAA）更適合大面積或房間級去污
blocks.en: H2O2 (VPHP) is the preferred sterilant for pharmaceutical isolator decontamination; peracetic acid (PAA) is better suited to large-area or room-level decontamination

blocks.zh: 半週期法（Half-Cycle）是最廣泛使用的驗證策略 — 找到最短全滅殺時間後加倍使用，簡單有效
blocks.en: The half-cycle approach is the most widely used validation strategy: find the minimum time to kill all BIs, then double it. It is simple and effective

blocks.zh: 括弧法（Bracketing）提供更寬的操作範圍驗證，同時評估材料相容性的上限
blocks.en: The bracketing approach validates a wider operating range while also assessing the upper limit of material compatibility

blocks.zh: 驗證活動包括設備確認、空腔分布、負載圖譜、BI 挑戰和製程確認 — 每個位置建議多個 BI
blocks.en: Validation activities include equipment qualification, cavity distribution, load mapping, BI challenge, and process qualification; multiple BIs per location are recommended

blocks.zh: 常規維護需涵蓋九大要素（校準、BI、CI、變更管制、預防保養等），確保持續維持已驗證狀態
blocks.en: Routine maintenance must cover the nine elements (calibration, BI, CI, change control, preventive maintenance, etc.) to ensure the validated state is maintained

blocks.zh: CDMO 效率重點：曝氣時間優化是提升隔離器產線利用率的最大機會
blocks.en: CDMO efficiency focus: optimizing aeration time is the biggest opportunity to improve isolator line utilization
